open_leads.title: MONAI Label GHSA-qc22-rmgc-vg94: CVE, affected versions and whether a fixed release exists
open_leads.note: letsdatascience (21 Nov) says the advisory states the fix 'will be included in the next MONAI Label release', lists 0.8.5 and earlier as affected, gives no release date and says 0.8.5 is still the newest package. It also reports 'CVE-2026-133968', CVSS 9.8 (via strix.ai), and workarounds (enable auth, restrict ANNOTATOR). BleepingComputer says a security update was released on 18 November. The advisory answered 403 to this worker and the gh API is repo-bound, so none of this could be checked at the original. Read the advisory, and Amazon's post (https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/security/chinese-nexus-actors-cairn-ai-agents-found-a-zero-day-on-their-own/), then fix 'action', 'cves' and the update sentence.

notes: The assigned page is an aggregator, so its new details (CVE, CVSS, versions, unreleased fix) were not written into the event: under checklist item 3 they must come from the advisory it relays, which could not be read. The event's one CyberView-voice claim that conflicts with that page (security update on 18 November) is now attributed to BleepingComputer. updated_at was bumped so the second review rechecks the change.
